name: Smashing Invoice
description: Admin invoicing tool: manage clients/employees/allocations and generate TCPDF tax invoices.
project_description:
This Smashing Invoice module has special features and easy to use. By using this module organization can generate month based and hour based invoice of its client listed employees to send payment invoice for its clients.

 Features 
 - This module is easy to use.

- Generate month based and hour based payment invoice.

- Generate pdf of the invoice.

 Post-Installation 
 After installation, enable this module and clear cache this can be seen as title Invoice service in admin drupal admin toolbar menu. Hover on it dropdown list appear. All related link can be seen by clicking Invoice service link.

 Additional Requirements 
 Smashing Invoice module requires TCPDF library.

 Recommended libraries 
 Install TCPDF library using composer command in root of the project given below:

 composer require tecnickcom/tcpdf
